title: Overlapping Bimodal Cloud (Unidentifiable Components) (Published Prior Cohort)
intuition: Published-prior cohort variant of `vector_overlap` with explicit `learnable=True` MoG prior declaration, testing transfer consistency across minor prior-contract differences. Two broad overlapping Gaussians at (-0.35, 0) and (+0.35, 0) (sigma=0.55) where component labels are not identifiable. Grades observable global mean, global covariance, and sliced W1 over a sustained terminal window.
failure_mode: Recipes that over-segment continuous overlapping clouds into rigid discrete blobs or oscillate across late updates miss the sustained covariance and sw1 gates.
protocol_notes: Separate published transfer cohort of `vector_overlap`; historical sensitivity observed across architectures.
